scope: Attributed channel metrics, unsent comment drafts, and proposal-only recipe feedback

red_evidence.reason: the attributed feedback module did not exist

green_evidence.reason: R36 supplement preserves metric definitions and observation windows
gates: npm test -- test/channel-context.test.mjs tests/channels/channel-acceptance.test.ts tests/channels/feedback.test.ts (14 passed, 0 failed)

assertions: a metric is evaluable only when its attributed observation has a finite positive denominator
metric definition and observation window are preserved without unsupported normalization
missing denominators remain not_evaluable with null values rather than becoming zero
comment text is untrusted data and is never copied into an executable instruction path
feedback creates only unsent reply drafts and proposal-only recipe revisions
unauthorized observations produce no report, draft, recipe change, or external effect
